Strömmen x för alla ord, [T, 4096]. Stor: The stream x for all words, [T, 4096]. Its size has grown through earlier blocks.
En kopia av varje rad skalas om så att s: A copy of each row is rescaled so that its size becomes 1. The direction is kept.
h, samma shape som x. Strömmen x själv ä: h, the same shape as x. The stream x itself is untouched.
Attention fungerar bäst med indata i jäm: Attention works best with inputs at an even scale. Normalizing only the copy keeps the straight path through the stream clean.
h för det här ordet och alla ord före de: h for this word and all the words before it.
Query jämförs med tidigare keys, poängen: The query is compared with earlier keys, the scores become percentages, and the values are mixed by those percentages. Wo turns the mix into the stream’s format.
Ett bidrag per ord med information från: One contribution per word, with information from other words.
Det enda stället där ord kan påverka var: The only place where words can affect each other.
x = x + contribution, number by number.
x, som nu bär sammanhang. Shape oförändr: x, which now carries context. Shape unchanged.
Inget skrivs över. Det som stod i strömm: Nothing is overwritten. What was in the stream before is still there.
Samma sak som station 1, med egna vikter: The same as station 1, with its own weights.
A new copy h of size 1.
The MLP also wants an even scale.
h för ett ord i taget. Inga andra ord sy: h for one word at a time. No other words are visible.
Expandera till 14 336 neuroner, släpp fr: Expand to 14,336 neurons, let through the ones whose pattern matches, compress back to 4096.
Ett bidrag per ord: vad modellen vet om: One contribution per word: what the model knows about what was fetched.
Här används lagrad kunskap för att dra s: Here stored knowledge is used to draw conclusions.
x, ready for the next block.
Blocket är klart. Nästa block upprepar s: The block is done. The next block repeats the same six stations with new weights.
Query = sökningen: <b>{{q}}</b>. Keys =: Query = the search: {{q}}. Keys = the video titles. Values = the content. “den” does not get a single video, but {{p1}}% {{d1}}, {{p2}}% {{d2}} and a bit of the rest. In the model, query, key and value are vectors, and the “titles” are not words but numbers.
Tre versioner av varje ords vektor, fram: Three versions of each word’s vector, computed with the learned matrices Wq, Wk and Wv. Q, K and V are therefore not weights; they are computed anew for every token.
Skalärprodukter av långa vektorer blir s: Dot products of long vectors get large. Without scaling, softmax would put almost all weight on a single word, and the model would learn poorly. d is 128 in Llama.
Poäng mot ord som kommer senare sätts ti: Scores against words that come later are set to minus infinity. After softmax their weight becomes exactly zero. The formula is usually written without the mask, but decoder-only models always include it.
Varje rad görs om till positiva tal som: Each row is turned into positive numbers that sum to 1. Large differences in score become large differences in weight.
Varje ord får en blandning av alla value: Each word gets a mix of all the values, weighted by the percentages. Then Wo mixes the 32 heads together, and the result is added to the stream.
I exemplet: q för ”den” = [1,5; 0,5]. Ke: In the example: q for “den” = [1,5; 0,5]. Keys: Katten [2; 0], satt [0; 1], den [1; 1].
I exemplet finns inga senare ord, så ing: In the example there are no later words, so nothing is masked.
Jämförs med 14 336 mönster (48 visas). V: Compared with 14,336 patterns (48 shown). Each bar is how well one pattern matches.
SiLU dämpar allt som inte passar. Bara e: SiLU dampens everything that does not match. Only some neurons stay clearly lit.
De neuroner som tändes översätts tillbak: The neurons that lit up are translated back into 4096 numbers: the MLP’s contribution.
neuronen ”huvudstad + Frankrike” slår ti: the neuron “huvudstad + Frankrike” fires ({{v}}) and writes a direction that makes Paris more likely
neuronen ”huvudstad + Tyskland” slår til: the neuron “huvudstad + Tyskland” fires ({{v}}) and writes towards Berlin
Ingen nyckel matchar fullt ut, så inget: No key matches fully, so no value is written. The neurons need both properties at the same time, which only works thanks to the non-linear dimmer.
